item.title: Battle Ground police search for suspects after series of animal shootings with blow darts

item.title: 2 Longview high school students arrested on rape, indecent exposure charges
item.description: Two juveniles were arrested in connection to an ongoing investigation into sexual abuse and rape at Mark Morris High School, and police are reviewing whether school staff followed mandatory reporting requirements.

item.title: Police identify four people arrested during Portland City Hall protest
item.description: Portland police released the identities and charges for four people arrested Thursday night after refusing to leave a city council meeting.

item.title: Oregon health officials are now calling measles an 'outbreak': What that means
item.description: Oregon Health Authority and Oregon Health and Science University are holding a media briefing to share an update on the state's five measles cases so far in 2026, four of which have been linked to unvaccinated individuals.

item.title: Black female executive at Nike champions women's sneakers
item.description: LaToya Kamara Manley is a successful Black female entrepreneur who has developed the first Jordan brand sneakers to target females, while also raising awareness about Autism in Black and brown communities.

item.title: Arrest made after 4th stalking, fondling incident reported near Portland Community College
item.description: Authorities have made an arrest after a fourth stalking and fondling incident at Portland Community College's Southeast Portland campus.

item.title: Ambitious Black-led project aims to reclaim Portland's gentrified Albina community
item.description: The Albina Vision Trust and The 1803 Fund are working together to reclaim 94 acres in Portland's Albina neighborhood, returning it to its historical roots and investing hundreds of millions of dollars for the Black community.
